intro: The Dominican Republic has about 11 million people.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Dominicans are of mixed European and African descent. Spanish is official. Many Haitians and people of Haitian descent live and work in the country.

chapters.title: Diaspora
text: Over two million Dominicans live in the US, especially New York.

keyTerms.meaning: The Indigenous people of the Caribbean islands.
